questions.question: Walk me through the Python data-preprocessing workflow you used on the dataset with over one million entries. What data-quality issues did you encounter, and how did you validate the cleaned output?

Describe a time when your analysis of Google Analytics data led to a recommendation for improving a mobile application’s customer support or user experience. What metrics did you examine and what was the outcome?

This role requires analyzing real-time driver earnings and marketplace levers. How would you use SQL to investigate an unexpected increase in driver incentive spend while determining whether it improved marketplace performance?
Tell me about the John Deere equipment-feature trend analysis you conducted using NLTK. How did you approach topic segmentation, assess the quality of the results, and communicate the trends?
At Hewlett Packard Enterprise, how did you extract, clean, and transform data into the management-specified format? What checks did you use to prevent errors in the final deliverable?
Describe a Tableau dashboard or visualization you created for senior stakeholders. How did you decide which metrics, filters, and visual design choices would best support decision-making?

Suppose weekly reporting shows that ride demand is stable but driver availability has declined in several markets. What analyses would you perform before recommending changes to earnings products or financial levers?
How would you design an experiment to evaluate whether a new real-time driver earnings incentive improves ride fulfillment while remaining financially sustainable?

Tell me about your consulting work on the intranet governance framework at Jones Lang LaSalle. How did you gather stakeholder input, translate it into a business model or process, and handle differing priorities?
Describe a situation where you had incomplete or ambiguous data requirements. How did you clarify the business question, structure your analysis, and present an actionable recommendation?
